generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every engagement in the current-year Annual Audit Plan record in AuditBoard
generic.In-scope period: The plan year for which hours are being budgeted and tracked
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Budgeted-hours field is populated for every engagement record in AuditBoard
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total budgeted hours reconcile to total available auditor headcount capacity
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Hours-allocation worksheet is attached to the plan record and version-dated
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any engagement without budgeted hours is logged and assigned an owner to fix
generic.Test population: All engagements listed in the Annual Audit Plan for the current cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires 100% of engagements budgeted and total hours within capacity
generic.Exception handling path: Unbudgeted or over-capacity engagements route back to the CAE for reallocation
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Hours are budgeted, split by phase, and reconciled to capacity before sign-off
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard Annual Audit Plan record, hours-allocation worksheet attachment

steps.title: Pull auditor capacity from the resourcing model in AuditBoard
sop: Open the resourcing module in AuditBoard for the plan year.
Export total available auditor headcount hours by grade.
Done when the capacity figure is confirmed against HR headcount.
verify: Compare exported capacity to the HR headcount report.
Pass when the capacity figure matches HR headcount within tolerance.

steps.title: Enter budgeted hours on each engagement record in AuditBoard
sop: Open every engagement record in the Annual Audit Plan module.
Enter a budgeted-hours figure split across planning, fieldwork, reporting and follow-up.
Save the record and move to the next engagement.
Done when every engagement record shows a populated budgeted-hours field.
verify: Filter the plan module for engagements with a blank budgeted-hours field.
Pass when the filter returns zero engagements.

steps.title: Reconcile total budgeted hours to available capacity in AuditBoard
sop: Sum budgeted hours across all engagement records in the plan module.
Compare the sum to the capacity figure pulled from the resourcing model.
Done when the two totals reconcile or the gap is explained.
verify: Recompute the sum from the exported engagement list.
Pass when the recomputed sum matches the reconciliation note.

steps.title: Carve out a contingency reserve in the hours-allocation worksheet
sop: Open the hours-allocation worksheet in SharePoint.
Label a reserve line separate from engagement-specific hours.
Confirm the reserve is excluded from per-engagement totals.
Done when the reserve line is labeled and quantified.
verify: Check the worksheet for a distinct, labeled reserve line.
Pass when the reserve line is present and excluded from engagement totals.

steps.title: Attach and version-date the hours-allocation worksheet to the plan record
sop: Save the finalized worksheet with a version number and date in the filename.
Upload the worksheet to the Annual Audit Plan record in AuditBoard.
Done when the worksheet is attached with a visible version and date.
verify: Open the plan record and confirm the attachment is present.
Pass when the attached file shows the correct version number and date.

steps.title: Review the hours allocation with the Chief Audit Executive
sop: Review the reconciled hours allocation and contingency reserve in AuditBoard.
Raise any concerns about workload distribution across auditors.
Done when the CAE confirms the allocation is acceptable.
verify: Check for the CAE's sign-off comment or approval flag on the plan record.
Pass when the CAE's approval is recorded on the plan record.

steps.title: Lock the hours allocation in AuditBoard ahead of plan drafting
sop: Set the plan record status to locked once CAE approval is recorded.
Confirm no further edits are possible to the budgeted-hours fields.
Done when the record status shows locked.
verify: Attempt to edit a budgeted-hours field after lock.
Pass when the field is read-only and the status shows locked.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every engagement in the current Annual Audit Plan awaiting an assigned lead
generic.In-scope period: The plan year covered by the current Annual Audit Plan cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Lead-auditor field is populated on every engagement record in AuditBoard
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of assigned engagements reconciles to total planned engagements
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment schedule is saved with a version date in AuditBoard
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Independence conflicts or workload breaches are logged with resolution
generic.Test population: All engagements in the current Annual Audit Plan
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every engagement assigned with no unresolved independence conflict
generic.Exception handling path: Conflicted or over-capacity assignments are reassigned by the CAE
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every engagement has a named lead within budgeted capacity and no conflicts
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard Annual Audit Plan record, assignment schedule attachment

steps.title: List unassigned engagements in the AuditBoard plan record
sop: Open the Annual Audit Plan module in AuditBoard.
Filter engagements where the lead-auditor field is blank.
Done when the unassigned list is exported for review.
verify: Re-run the filter after export.
Pass when the exported list matches the current unassigned count.

steps.title: Check auditor independence declarations before assignment
sop: Pull the current independence declaration for each candidate auditor.
Compare declarations against the auditee for each unassigned engagement.
Flag any conflict found before proposing an assignment.
Done when every candidate is cleared or flagged.
verify: Cross-check flagged conflicts against the declaration file.
Pass when no cleared auditor has an open conflict with their proposed auditee.

steps.title: Propose lead auditor for each engagement in AuditBoard
sop: Enter a proposed lead auditor on each unassigned engagement record.
Reference the budgeted hours to confirm workload fit.
Done when every engagement carries a proposed lead.
verify: Filter the plan for engagements still missing a lead.
Pass when the filter returns zero engagements.

steps.title: Confirm auditor workload does not exceed budgeted capacity
sop: Sum proposed hours per auditor across all assigned engagements.
Compare each auditor's total to their budgeted-hours capacity.
Done when no auditor exceeds capacity or an overage is flagged.
verify: Recompute the per-auditor totals independently.
Pass when no unresolved overage remains.

steps.title: Flag co-source or specialist resource needs on engagement records
sop: Review each engagement for specialist skill requirements (IT, actuarial, fraud).
Tag engagements needing co-source or specialist resource in AuditBoard.
Done when all specialist needs are tagged.
verify: Review tagged engagements against the specialist need identified in scoping.
Pass when every specialist need is tagged.

steps.title: Obtain CAE sign-off on the assignment schedule in AuditBoard
sop: Review the proposed assignment schedule for conflicts and workload balance.
Approve or request changes to specific assignments.
Done when the CAE records approval on the assignment schedule.
verify: Check the assignment schedule for the CAE's approval flag.
Pass when the CAE approval is recorded with a date.

steps.title: Communicate the assignment schedule to lead auditors
sop: Export the approved assignment schedule with target start dates.
Send the schedule to each named lead auditor.
Done when every lead auditor has received their assignment and start date.
verify: Check the send log for confirmation to each lead auditor.
Pass when every lead auditor is confirmed as notified.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every auditable entity compiled from the enterprise risk register
generic.In-scope period: The current risk register snapshot used for this planning cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each universe entry has a name, level (process/entity/legal-entity) and risk register link
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Universe entity count reconciles to risk register entry count, with variances explained
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Universe extract is timestamped to the risk register snapshot in the GRC platform
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Entities without a matching risk register entry are flagged for risk-team follow-up
generic.Test population: All entities in the compiled auditable-entity universe
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every entity mapped to a risk register entry or logged as flagged
generic.Exception handling path: Unmapped entities route to the Risk Analyst for risk-register follow-up
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Universe covers process, entity and legal-entity levels and retires stale entries
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform universe extract, dated to the risk register snapshot

steps.title: Extract the current risk register from the GRC platform
sop: Open the enterprise risk register module in the GRC platform.
Export all active risk register entries with entity identifiers.
Done when the export is timestamped to the current snapshot.
verify: Check the export file properties for the snapshot timestamp.
Pass when the timestamp matches the current risk register cycle.

steps.title: Compile the auditable-entity list in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Pull organizational entity, process and legal-entity lists from the data warehouse.
Merge the lists into a single candidate auditable-entity universe.
Done when the merged list covers all three entity levels.
verify: Spot-check the merged list for process, entity and legal-entity rows.
Pass when all three levels are represented.

steps.title: Map each auditable entity to a risk register entry in the GRC platform
sop: Match each universe entity to its corresponding risk register entry.
Record the risk register entry ID against the universe record.
Done when every mapped entity shows a linked risk register ID.
verify: Sample mapped entities and confirm the linked ID exists in the register.
Pass when sampled links resolve correctly.

steps.title: Flag universe entities without a risk register match
sop: Identify universe entities with no corresponding risk register entry.
Log each unmatched entity for risk-team follow-up in the GRC platform.
Done when all unmatched entities are logged with a follow-up owner.
verify: Review the flagged list against the merge results.
Pass when every unmatched entity has a logged follow-up owner.

steps.title: Retire prior-year universe entries that no longer exist
sop: Compare the current universe to the prior-year universe list.
Mark entries no longer present as retired rather than deleting them.
Done when all obsolete entries are marked retired.
verify: Check the prior-year list for entries missing a retired marker.
Pass when every removed entity is marked retired, not silently dropped.

steps.title: Review the compiled universe with the Risk Analyst
sop: Review the compiled universe and flagged entities for completeness.
Confirm the risk register snapshot used matches the scoring cycle.
Done when the Risk Analyst confirms the universe is ready for scoring.
verify: Check for the Risk Analyst's review confirmation on the universe file.
Pass when the confirmation is recorded.

steps.title: File the finalized universe extract in the GRC platform
sop: Save the finalized universe list with the risk register snapshot date.
Attach the file to the planning workpaper in the GRC platform.
Done when the extract is filed and timestamped.
verify: Open the filed extract and confirm the timestamp is present.
Pass when the extract is filed with the correct snapshot date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is all controls/entities covered by either internal or external audit
generic.In-scope period: The current audit-plan year being coordinated with the external auditor
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage map lists each control/entity with the covering party identified
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Mapped controls reconcile to the combined internal and external audit scope
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Coverage map and meeting minutes are filed with a version date in SharePoint
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverage gaps are logged and added back into the internal audit universe
generic.Test population: All controls/entities in the combined internal and external audit scope
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a documented coverage map with no unaddressed gap
generic.Exception handling path: Gaps route back into the audit universe for risk scoring
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Coverage map, reliance rationale and meeting minutes are complete and filed
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint coordination file, GRC platform plan record

steps.title: Request the external auditor's control coverage scope
sop: Contact the external audit engagement partner for their planned control coverage.
Record the scope received in the coordination file in SharePoint.
Done when the external scope is documented.
verify: Compare the recorded scope to the partner's correspondence.
Pass when the documented scope matches what was received.

steps.title: Build the coverage map in the GRC platform
sop: List each control/entity and tag it as internal-covered, external-covered or both.
Enter the coverage map into the GRC platform coordination record.
Done when every control/entity carries a coverage tag.
verify: Filter the map for controls with no coverage tag.
Pass when the filter returns zero controls.

steps.title: Document planned reliance on external audit work
sop: Identify areas where internal audit will rely on external audit testing.
Record the rationale for reliance in the plan file.
Done when every reliance area has a documented rationale.
verify: Review reliance areas against the rationale entries.
Pass when each reliance area has a rationale on file.

steps.title: Hold the joint coordination meeting with the external auditor
sop: Schedule the coordination meeting with the external audit engagement partner.
Capture discussion points and agreements as meeting minutes.
Done when minutes are logged in SharePoint.
verify: Check SharePoint for the filed meeting minutes.
Pass when minutes are present with the meeting date.

steps.title: Add identified coverage gaps back into the audit universe
sop: Review the coverage map for controls/entities with no assigned coverage.
Add each gap back into the internal audit universe in the GRC platform.
Done when every gap is entered into the universe for scoring.
verify: Cross-check the universe for the newly added gap entities.
Pass when every identified gap appears in the universe.

steps.title: Summarize the coordination outcome for the Audit Committee
sop: Draft a summary of the coverage map, reliance areas and gaps closed.
Attach the summary to the plan file shared with the Audit Committee.
Done when the summary is filed with the plan.
verify: Open the plan file and confirm the summary is attached.
Pass when the summary reflects the finalized coverage map.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every engagement proposed for the draft Annual Audit Plan
generic.In-scope period: The upcoming plan year covered by the draft
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Draft includes scope, methodology, resourcing and coverage-rationale sections
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Engagement count in the draft reconciles to the prioritized universe list
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft is saved as a version-controlled file pending CAE review
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Regulatory coverage gaps are called out in a red-amber-green summary
generic.Test population: All engagements proposed in the draft plan
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every section complete and each engagement showing risk score and history
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete engagement entries route back to the Internal Auditor for completion
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Draft is complete, references the universe/scoring model, and is version-controlled
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint draft-plan file, AuditBoard plan record

steps.title: Pull the risk-ranked universe into the draft plan template
sop: Open the risk-ranked auditable-entity list from the scoring workpaper.
Import the ranked engagements into the draft plan template in SharePoint.
Done when every ranked entity appears as a candidate engagement.
verify: Compare the draft's engagement list to the ranked universe.
Pass when every ranked entity is represented.

steps.title: Draft the scope, methodology and resourcing sections
sop: Write the scope, methodology and resource-allocation sections of the draft.
Reference the hours-allocation worksheet for resourcing figures.
Done when all three sections are complete.
verify: Check the draft for each required section.
Pass when scope, methodology and resourcing sections are all present.

steps.title: Add risk score, prior history and planned quarter to each engagement
sop: Populate each engagement row with its risk score from the scoring workpaper.
Add prior audit history and the planned execution quarter.
Done when every engagement row is fully populated.
verify: Filter engagement rows for missing risk score or quarter.
Pass when the filter returns zero rows.

steps.title: Build the regulatory coverage-gap summary in the draft
sop: Compare planned engagements against mandatory regulatory audit requirements.
Add a red-amber-green summary of coverage gaps to the draft.
Done when the summary reflects the current gap-validation results.
verify: Cross-check the summary against the regulatory validation workpaper.
Pass when the ratings match the validation results.

steps.title: Cross-reference the draft to the universe and scoring model
sop: Add citations in the draft to the universe extract and scoring workpaper used.
Confirm the references resolve to the correct filed documents.
Done when every prioritization claim is cross-referenced.
verify: Follow each cross-reference to confirm it opens the correct source document.
Pass when all references resolve correctly.

steps.title: Save the draft as a version-controlled file pending CAE review
sop: Save the completed draft with a version number and date in SharePoint.
Route the draft to the Chief Audit Executive for review.
Done when the version-controlled draft is filed and routed.
verify: Open the file properties and confirm version and date are set.
Pass when the CAE confirms receipt of the routed draft.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every mid-year change proposed to the Annual Audit Plan
generic.In-scope period: The current plan year's mid-cycle adjustment window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each plan change entry names the triggering risk, source and rationale
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Revised hours budget reconciles after each add or remove
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Plan-change log is version-dated and retained in AuditBoard
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Dropped engagements are documented with rationale for the audit trail
generic.Test population: All plan changes logged during the mid-year adjustment cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every change logged with source, rationale and reconciled hours
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled hours changes route back to the Internal Auditor before logging
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Plan-change log is complete and ready for Audit Committee endorsement
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard plan-change log, GRC platform risk register reference

steps.title: Identify the emerging risk trigger in the GRC platform
sop: Review risk register updates, incidents or regulatory alerts since plan approval.
Identify which emerging risks warrant a plan change.
Done when each candidate trigger is documented with its source.
verify: Check each trigger for a cited source (register update, incident, alert).
Pass when every candidate trigger has a cited source.

steps.title: Log the proposed engagement addition or removal in AuditBoard
sop: Add or remove the affected engagement in the AuditBoard plan record.
Enter the reason for the change referencing the emerging risk.
Done when the change is logged with its reason.
verify: Open the plan-change log and confirm the reason is recorded.
Pass when every logged change shows a reason.

steps.title: Reconcile the revised hours budget after the adjustment
sop: Recalculate total budgeted hours after the add or remove.
Compare the revised total to available auditor capacity.
Done when the revised budget reconciles or a gap is flagged.
verify: Recompute the revised total independently.
Pass when the recomputed total matches the reconciliation.

steps.title: Document rationale for any dropped engagement
sop: Record why a previously planned engagement was dropped.
File the rationale against the engagement in the plan-change log.
Done when every dropped engagement has documented rationale.
verify: Review dropped engagements for a rationale entry.
Pass when every dropped engagement has one.

steps.title: Prepare the plan-change log for Audit Committee endorsement
sop: Compile all mid-year changes with triggers, reasons and reconciled hours.
Save the compiled log ready for Committee review.
Done when the log is complete and filed in AuditBoard.
verify: Review the compiled log against the individual change entries.
Pass when the log contains every logged change.

steps.title: Review the plan-change log with the Risk Analyst
sop: Confirm each change's emerging-risk trigger is still current.
Note any trigger that has since been superseded.
Done when the Risk Analyst confirms the log is current.
verify: Check for the Risk Analyst's confirmation note on the log.
Pass when confirmation is recorded before Committee submission.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is the draft Annual Audit Plan being pre-approved
generic.In-scope period: The plan year covered by the draft under review
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Meeting record includes date, attendees and feedback captured
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Deck version uploaded matches the latest draft plan version
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Meeting minutes and deck are filed in the board portal with dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requested scope or resourcing changes are tracked to resolution
generic.Test population: The single pre-approval review meeting for this plan cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires the meeting held, minuted, and feedback resolved before publication
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved feedback routes back to the Internal Auditor to revise the draft
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Chair's pre-approval comments are incorporated before full Committee submission
generic.Evidence location: Board portal meeting record, SharePoint draft-plan file

steps.title: Schedule the pre-approval review meeting in the board portal
sop: Coordinate a meeting date with the CAE and Audit Committee Chair.
Log the meeting invite in the board portal.
Done when the meeting is scheduled and logged.
verify: Check the board portal calendar for the logged meeting.
Pass when the meeting appears with date and attendees.

steps.title: Upload the latest draft plan deck to the board portal
sop: Confirm the deck reflects the most recent draft plan version.
Upload the deck to the board portal ahead of the meeting.
Done when the uploaded deck matches the latest draft.
verify: Compare the uploaded deck's version to the SharePoint draft file.
Pass when the versions match.

steps.title: Hold the review meeting and capture feedback
sop: Present the draft plan to the Audit Committee Chair.
Capture feedback and requested changes in the meeting minutes.
Done when minutes recording the feedback are logged.
verify: Open the logged minutes for the meeting.
Pass when feedback items are individually recorded.

steps.title: Track requested scope or resourcing changes to resolution
sop: List each change requested at the review meeting.
Update the draft plan to address each item.
Done when every requested change is resolved or explained.
verify: Check each requested item for a resolution note.
Pass when all requested changes are resolved or explained.

steps.title: Incorporate the Chair's pre-approval comments into the draft
sop: Apply the Chair's specific comments to the draft plan document.
Save the updated draft with a new version number.
Done when all comments are incorporated into the new version.
verify: Compare the new draft version against the Chair's comment list.
Pass when every comment is reflected in the updated draft.

steps.title: File the meeting minutes in the engagement record
sop: Save the finalized meeting minutes to the plan file in SharePoint.
Link the minutes to the plan record in AuditBoard.
Done when the minutes are filed and linked.
verify: Open the plan record and confirm the minutes link resolves.
Pass when the minutes are accessible from the plan record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every mid-year plan change presented for Committee endorsement
generic.In-scope period: The mid-year adjustment window for the current plan year
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each changed engagement lists the reason for addition, removal or reschedule
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Presented changes reconcile to the AuditBoard plan-change log
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Change summary is uploaded to the board portal with a version date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Committee-requested additional coverage is logged as a new plan item
generic.Test population: All mid-year changes summarized for this Committee cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires the summary presented and endorsement minuted
generic.Exception handling path: Non-endorsed changes route back to the Internal Auditor for rework
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Endorsed changes are reflected back into the AuditBoard plan record
generic.Evidence location: Board portal change summary, AuditBoard plan-change log

steps.title: Compile the mid-year change summary from the AuditBoard log
sop: Export all logged mid-year changes from AuditBoard.
Summarize each change with its reason for the Committee.
Done when the summary covers every logged change.
verify: Compare the summary to the AuditBoard plan-change log.
Pass when every logged change appears in the summary.

steps.title: Upload the change summary to the board portal
sop: Save the summary in the board portal ahead of the meeting.
Confirm the upload meets the Committee's lead-time requirement.
Done when the summary is uploaded on time.
verify: Check the board portal upload timestamp against the meeting date.
Pass when the upload meets the lead-time requirement.

steps.title: Present the changes and capture Committee endorsement
sop: Present each changed engagement and its rationale to the Committee.
Record the Committee's endorsement decision in the meeting minutes.
Done when endorsement is minuted.
verify: Open the meeting minutes for the endorsement record.
Pass when the endorsement decision is explicitly minuted.

steps.title: Reflect endorsed changes back into the AuditBoard plan record
sop: Update the AuditBoard plan record to match the endorsed changes.
Confirm the plan record and change summary now agree.
Done when the plan record reflects every endorsed change.
verify: Compare the plan record to the endorsed change summary.
Pass when they match exactly.

steps.title: Log any Committee-requested additional coverage as a new plan item
sop: Capture any new coverage the Committee requests during the meeting.
Add the request as a new item in the AuditBoard plan record.
Done when the requested coverage is logged as a plan item.
verify: Check the plan record for the newly logged coverage item.
Pass when the item is present with a source reference to the meeting.

steps.title: Archive the change summary in the plan-change file
sop: Save the presented change summary to the engagement file in SharePoint.
Confirm the archived copy matches what was presented to the Committee.
Done when the change summary is archived.
verify: Open the archived file and confirm it matches the presented version.
Pass when the archived copy is accurate and dated.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every entity in the auditable-entity universe being prioritized
generic.In-scope period: The current planning cycle's scoring and prioritization window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each entity has inherent risk, control-environment and prior-result scores
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ranked list count reconciles to the full auditable-entity universe
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Ranked list is exported and attached to the plan-drafting workpaper
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Entities unaudited in three years are flagged regardless of score
generic.Test population: All entities in the auditable-entity universe
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a reproducible ranking covering the full universe
generic.Exception handling path: Entities missing an input score route to the Risk Analyst for scoring
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Top-tier entities are scheduled earlier and the ranking is reproducible
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform scoring workpaper, Power BI ranked-list export

steps.title: Pull inherent risk and control-environment scores from the GRC platform
sop: Extract inherent risk and control-environment ratings for every universe entity.
Confirm each entity has both scores populated.
Done when the extract covers the full universe.
verify: Filter the extract for entities missing either score.
Pass when the filter returns zero entities.

steps.title: Apply the documented scoring weights in Power BI
sop: Load the extract into the Power BI scoring model.
Apply the documented weighting formula to compute a composite score.
Done when every entity has a composite score.
verify: Recompute one entity's score by hand from the raw inputs.
Pass when the manual recomputation matches the model output.

steps.title: Rank entities and confirm the ranking is reproducible
sop: Sort entities by composite score to produce the priority ranking.
Re-run the model with the same inputs to confirm identical output.
Done when the rerun produces the same ranking.
verify: Compare the two model runs' rankings side by side.
Pass when the rankings are identical.

steps.title: Flag entities not audited in the trailing three years
sop: Compare each entity's last-audited date to the three-year threshold.
Flag entities exceeding the threshold regardless of their score.
Done when all overdue entities are flagged.
verify: Check flagged entities against the last-audited date field.
Pass when every entity over three years is flagged.

steps.title: Schedule top risk-tier entities earlier in the plan year
sop: Review the ranked list for the top risk tier.
Assign earlier planned quarters to top-tier entities in AuditBoard.
Done when top-tier entities show earlier scheduling.
verify: Compare top-tier entity quarters to lower-tier entity quarters.
Pass when top-tier entities are scheduled no later than mid-year.

steps.title: Export and attach the ranked list to the plan-drafting workpaper
sop: Export the final ranked list from Power BI.
Attach the export to the plan-drafting workpaper in AuditBoard.
Done when the ranked list is attached and dated.
verify: Open the plan-drafting workpaper and confirm the attachment.
Pass when the attached list matches the finalized ranking.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is the Committee-approved Annual Audit Plan being published

sop: Compare the plan file to be published against the approved version on file.
Confirm no edits were made after Committee approval.
Done when the two versions match exactly.
verify: Run a line-by-line comparison of the two files.
Pass when no unauthorized differences are found.

steps.title: Upload the approved plan as the controlling record in AuditBoard
sop: Upload the approved plan to the AuditBoard plan record.
Set the record status to the year's controlling version.
Done when the controlling record is set.
verify: Open the AuditBoard record and confirm the controlling-version flag.
Pass when the flag is set on the correct file.

steps.title: Distribute the plan to engagement leads and stakeholders
sop: Compile the distribution list of engagement leads, business stakeholders and the CAE.
Send the approved plan to the compiled list.
Done when all recipients have received the plan.
verify: Check the send confirmation against the compiled distribution list.
Pass when every recipient shows as sent.

steps.title: Log the distribution list and send date for the audit trail
sop: Record the distribution list and send date in the engagement file.
File the log in SharePoint alongside the plan.
Done when the log is filed with date and recipients.
verify: Open the filed log and confirm date and recipients are present.
Pass when the log matches the actual send.

steps.title: Archive superseded draft versions in SharePoint
sop: Move prior draft versions to an archive folder in SharePoint.
Mark archived versions as non-authoritative.
Done when all drafts are archived and marked.
verify: Check the archive folder for the non-authoritative marking.
Pass when every prior draft is marked non-authoritative.

steps.title: Confirm engagement leads acknowledge receipt of the plan
sop: Request acknowledgment of receipt from each engagement lead.
Track acknowledgments against the distribution list.
Done when every engagement lead has acknowledged receipt.
verify: Check the distribution list for outstanding acknowledgments.
Pass when every lead has acknowledged receipt.
